one_liner: AI web app for CA firms that reconciles books against GST portal data and drafts tax-notice replies for the CA to review.
sub_sector: B2B vertical SaaS / AI for CA firms (GST compliance)
ask: INR 1.5 Cr at INR 10 Cr post-money
business_model: Seat-based subscription of INR 2,500-6,000 per firm per month plus INR 400 per drafted notice reply above plan limit.

founders.name: Dhruv Shah
founders.background_claimed: Qualified Chartered Accountant; 4 years in practice handling GST for about 60 clients.

founders.name: Isha Merchant
founders.background_claimed: 3 years at a SaaS company; built the matching engine.

claims.text: Paying-customer count differs: deck says 31 paying CA firms; form says 24 paying CA firms plus 7 on free trial.
claims.note: The deck appears to count free-trial firms as paying (24 + 7 = 31).

claims.text: MRR is INR 78,000 (October); the deck's 'INR 9.4 L annual recurring revenue' is October MRR x 12, not contracted annual revenue.
claims.note: MRR ran INR 18k -> 41k -> 78k (Aug-Oct). Fast growth from a small base over three months; the ARR label overstates maturity.

claims.text: Implied average revenue is ~INR 3,250 per paying firm per month (78,000 / 24), inside the stated INR 2,500-6,000 seat-based plan range; extra notice replies are INR 400 each.
2 firms have churned (out of ~26 that ever paid).
claims.note: Churn base and timing not given; product is ~8 months old.

claims.text: Customer acquisition is mostly founders' network and CA referrals; acquisition cost has not been measured.
claims.note: Earned rather than bought, but untested beyond the founders' network.

claims.text: Liability: every drafted reply is reviewed by the CA before filing; responsibility sits with the CA.
Founders name model errors on unusual notices and dependence on GST portal data formats as key risks.
Deck claims competitors (Tally/Zoho, ClearTax) do not offer AI notice replies.
claims.note: Contradicted by the web: GST Reply AI sells AI-drafted GST notice replies (W1). Not a deck-vs-form contradiction but a deck-vs-web one.

claims.text: GST Reply AI offers AI-drafted replies to GST notices from INR 299 per reply, with an INR 999/month unlimited plan for CA firms (per a comment on its launch page).
claims.note: Undercuts CAPilot's INR 400 per extra reply and its INR 2,500-6,000 monthly plans on the notice-reply job.

claims.text: Vyapar TaxOne markets AI-driven GST reconciliation for CAs ('automate reconciliations, and identify errors').
claims.note: Search snippets (CB Insights, directories) say TaxOne was formerly Suvit, a Surat CA-automation startup; suvit.io URLs now redirect to taxone.vyapar.com (observed during this run). Funding of a well-distributed accounting player into the same job.

claims.text: Third-party GST tools operate as Application Service Providers, connecting to the GST system through GSTN-approved GST Suvidha Providers (GSPs).
claims.note: Relevant to the founders' stated dependence on GST portal data; the application does not say whether CAPilot uses a GSP/API route or manual uploads.

claims.text: ICAI data shows roughly 99,000 CA firms (98,967 as of 28 February 2025).
claims.note: Bottom-up market: even at 150 firms CAPilot would have ~0.15% of firms. The deck instead sizes the market as 1% of an INR 1.4 lakh Cr services market (D8), which is services revenue, not software spend.

claims.text: Market is sized top-down: 'Even 1% of this market is a INR 1,400 Cr opportunity'.
Problem claims (staff spend ~40% of time matching GST invoices; each notice reply takes 3-5 hours) are unsourced founder statements.
Sector mismatch: selected 'Fintech', but the product is AI workflow software for CA firms (tax-compliance SaaS); no money movement or lending. Classified as other (B2B vertical SaaS).
claims.note: Relevant to gate G3 / stated-lens S1.

claims.text: Founders: Dhruv Shah (CEO) claims to be a qualified CA with 4 years in practice handling GST for about 60 clients; Isha Merchant (CTO) claims 3 years at a SaaS company and built the matching engine. Full-time since February 2026; no prior startups.
Founder LinkedIn links are placeholders (*-example) and the website is a .example domain; no independent footprint for founders or company found.
12-month target: 150 paying firms and INR 7 L MRR (implies ~INR 4,670 per firm, above today's ~INR 3,250).
Raising INR 1.5 Cr at INR 10 Cr post-money; one angel has invested INR 15 L; no other investors in conversation; 20% of funds for compliance and security.
